contract_provenance.note: The exact model form, source hashes, 28-clade common frame, lambda and half-depth outputs, and absolute-time prohibition were committed in the failing contract test before PR #299 froze persistence outcomes. This JSON was materialized later and is therefore not described as a prospective preregistration.

primary_model.fit: maximize Bernoulli pairwise pseudo_log_likelihood with q fixed
primary_model.optimization: bounded scalar optimization on log(lambda) from log(1e-4) to log(1e4)

half_depth_interpretation: relative divergence depth at which modelled excess same-state retention above q falls to one half of its d=0 value

cross_resolution_summary.primary_descriptive: median half_depth_ln2_over_lambda at coarse, intermediate and fine resolution
cross_resolution_summary.pairwise_followup: two-sided paired Wilcoxon only if Friedman p<=0.05
cross_resolution_summary.winner_count: resolution with largest half_depth within each clade; ties retained

boundary_handling.upper_boundary_means: decay indistinguishable from effectively immediate loss on the normalized scale; retain as boundary estimate rather than dropping clade
boundary_handling.lower_boundary_means: memory remains effectively undiminished across the normalized crown-depth range; retain as boundary estimate

primary_cross_resolution_question: does relative state-persistence timescale vary among coarse_intermediate_fine representations across clades
claim_boundary: relative crown-depth scale only, not millions of years
pairwise pseudo-likelihood is an estimand fit; species pairs are not independent inferential replicates
this analysis reuses the same source states and trees as AUC/persistence analyses and is not independent replication
the pre-outcome contract predates PR #299 but the machine-readable preregistration object was materialized after outcome exposure
